answer: Agents submit zero-knowledge attestations from TPM/SGX enclaves, binding code, device keys, and monotonic counters to the saffron state tree. delta is a VDF-verified epoch anchor; sable is the consensus contract accepting only unused proofs. Forging identities requires enclave compromise or distinct physical silicon plus sequential VDF computation. Registration uses an O(N^2) quadratic bonding curve, and failed proofs trigger irreversible collateral slashing.
